Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on 30 October 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently-abled Relaxation may be considered as per rules | Other conditions: | Strong programming skills in C/C++/Python/MATLAB Knowledge of image processing | Desirable: | M.E./M.Tech./PhD in CS / IT / Electronics / Elec. how_to_apply: Appear for the walk-in interview on 30th October, 2026 at 11:30 AM.
Submit a covering letter addressed to the Professor-in-Charge, Computer and Communication Sciences Division.

Bring a current CV (signed) in English containing Name, Date of birth, Permanent/Present Address, E-mail, Telephone/Mobile No., Alternative contact no., Parent's/Spouse's Name, Academic Qualifications from 10th standard, Experience, Programming languages known, Aadhar Card No., SC/ST/OBC/Differently-abled status.
Bring self-attested copies of all documents and testimonials.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the post.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 October 2026, and candidates report at 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project-linked personnel.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 30 October 2026 at 11:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on 30 October 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently-abled Relaxation may be considered as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 32000 - Rs. 37000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E./B. Tech. in CS/IT/Electronics/Elec. Engg./ equivalent or MCA or M.Sc. in CS / IT / Electronics / Math./Stat./Physics or equivalent with strong programming skills.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Strong programming skills in C/C++/Python/MATLAB. Knowledge of image processing.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Written test in the subject area may be held, if required, to shortlist candidates. Written test in the subject area if required.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on temporary basis. Valid till March 31, 2027.
